definitions: A series of regulations limiting the ingredients in beer in Germany and its predecessors.
The German Beer Purity Law of 1516, which stipulated that beer may only contain water, barley, and hops (yeast was later added).
examples: The Reinheitsgebot has influenced brewing for centuries.
Many German brewers still adhere to the Reinheitsgebot.
The Reinheitsgebot is a significant part of German cultural heritage.
